reported_metrics.metric: USDC in circulation at quarter end

reported_metrics.caveat: Not net external settlement, not net new capital, and not unique customer payment volume. May include exchange, DeFi, internal and repeated transfers.
This is not $14.7B of actual Q2 settled volume. Underlying trailing-30-day realized volume is not stated as a separate number.
Enrolled is not synonymous with active, live, transacting or production-volume contribution.

reported_metrics.metric: USDC share of Circle Agent Stack x402 agent-payment volume
reported_metrics.caveat: This is volume share within Circle's Agent Stack x402 context, not share of all agentic payments, all x402 transactions, or global payments.

reported_metrics.metric: Paid services on Circle Agent Stack
reported_metrics.caveat: Service count is not payment volume, active users or settlement capital.

institutional_relationships.relationship: Circle expanded its partnership with BNY; BNY added USDC minting and redemption directly within its Digital Asset Custody platform, building on BNY's existing role as primary custodian of USDC reserves.
institutional_relationships.operational_limit: No client-level USDC balance, custody AUC/A or mint/redemption volume through BNY is disclosed in this announcement.

institutional_relationships.relationship: Circle says Marex enabled the first stablecoin-powered initial-margin transaction in regulated derivatives clearing, allowing institutional clients to post USDC as collateral for CFTC-regulated derivatives under a December 2025 CFTC no-action letter.
institutional_relationships.operational_limit: The announcement does not disclose collateral balance, transaction count, client count, or the proportion of Marex initial margin represented by USDC.

institutional_relationships.relationship: Circle says Nium connected USDC settlement to its global payout infrastructure across more than 190 countries through CPN.
institutional_relationships.operational_limit: 190+ country reach is network coverage, not actual payments in every country; route-level volume and active-corridor count are undisclosed.

institutional_relationships.relationship: Circle says JCB combined Circle stablecoin infrastructure with its merchant network, initially focusing on cross-border treasury transfers and in-store stablecoin payment experiences in Japan.
institutional_relationships.operational_limit: No production go-live date, merchant count, settlement value or XRP integration disclosed.

institutional_relationships.relationship: Circle identifies SBI Group as a founding third-party validator in Arc's validator cohort.
institutional_relationships.operational_limit: This is an SBI Group/Arc governance-validator relationship, not a relationship with the separate Japanese SBIC regional companies and not evidence of XRP purchases.

institutional_relationships.relationship: Circle says BlackRock was expected to deploy BUIDL on Arc.
institutional_relationships.operational_limit: The Q2 announcement is forward-looking; it does not itself prove current deployed balances or live settlement.

institutional_relationships.relationship: Circle says DTCC would enable tokenization of DTC-custodied assets on Arc.
institutional_relationships.operational_limit: Do not treat this as completed tokenization or actual XRP/RLUSD capital.

relationship_graph.relation: direct institutional access within Digital Asset Custody
reported initial-margin collateral use for regulated derivatives

separate October 27 USDC settlement pilot in Colombia

actual_capital_reconciliation.14.8T_onchain_volume: Gross repeated transaction activity across USDC networks; not net new capital or external settlement.
actual_capital_reconciliation.14.7B_CPN_annualized: Trailing-30-day run rate multiplied/expressed annually; not actual quarter settlement.
actual_capital_reconciliation.175_FI_enrolled: Enrollment count; not necessarily active production users.
actual_capital_reconciliation.99.3_percent_x402: Volume share within Circle Agent Stack's x402 activity; not global market share.
actual_capital_reconciliation.900_plus_paid_services: Catalog size; not users or transaction count.
actual_capital_reconciliation.Marex_USDC_collateral: Qualitative company-reported use; actual posted amount undisclosed.
actual_capital_reconciliation.Nium_190_plus_countries: Potential coverage footprint; actual active corridor usage undisclosed.

competing_hypotheses.claim: USDC is gaining institutional collateral utility beyond spot trading, including regulated derivatives margin.
competing_hypotheses.support: Circle's report identifies Marex initial-margin use and BNY mint/redemption access.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_or_unknown: No USDC collateral amount, open positions, client concentration or repeated transaction series disclosed.

competing_hypotheses.claim: CPN's $14.7B annualized figure indicates meaningful institutional settlement adoption.
competing_hypotheses.support: Circle reports 175 enrolled institutions and a 76% quarter-over-quarter increase in annualized trailing-30-day volume.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_or_unknown: The $14.7B is a run rate, not actual Q2 volume; enrollment does not prove activity; no route-level net settlement or independent payment-rail reconciliation is provided.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Circle's bank, collateral, payout and agentic-payment integrations could compete with XRP-based bridge and payment use cases.
competing_hypotheses.support: Marex, Nium, JCB, BNY and ACI relationships broaden USDC's institutional utility.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_or_unknown: No corridor-by-corridor XRP-versus-USDC cost, FX, speed, depth or market-share comparison. USDC is also native on XRPL and can complement XRPL activity.

feature_admission.usdc_circulation: Point-in-time supply stock, separate by chain and issuer/bridge contract.
feature_admission.usdc_onchain_volume: Gross activity feature only after de-duplication and classification; never label as actual capital.
feature_admission.cpn_annualized_run_rate: Keep distinct from realized trailing-30-day volume and quarterly settled value.
feature_admission.fi_enrollment: Enrollment metric only; do not equate with active institutions.
feature_admission.marex_collateral: Qualitative collateral-use event until amounts and timestamps are disclosed.
feature_admission.nium_and_jcb: Integration/coverage events only until actual settlement volumes are disclosed.
feature_admission.xrp_demand: No XRP demand or price-direction feature admitted from Circle's USDC metrics.

forecast.reason: The reported metrics establish institutional product reach and use cases but do not provide synchronized net external settlement, XRP bridge usage or calibrated causal evidence for a directional XRP forecast.

next_actions: Reconcile Circle's November 4 Q3 results with Q2 run-rate definitions and actual USDC circulation.
Seek realized trailing-30-day CPN settlement value, active institution count and corridor distribution, separating gross from net.
Track BNY USDC mint/redemption volumes and compare with its RLUSD reserve-custody role.
Track Marex USDC collateral amounts and eligible collateral rules; compare with Coinbase XRP/cbXRP collateral channels.
Measure Nium and JCB production go-live, active routes, settlement value and FX costs.
Measure whether USDC activity on XRPL produces direct RLUSD/USDC flows or executed XRP bridge swaps.
